args.summary: 西红柿炒蛋 is plated (t=643 s), and neither the smoke detector nor the stove guard went off. 1) 润锅: heated oil to coat the wok, then poured it out into the oil cup. 2) 煎: added the 3 beaten eggs (150 g) at about 120 °C, fried them on low heat, flipped, and took them out into the holding bowl at about 125 °C. 3) 炒: 2 tomatoes (300 g of wedges) fried on low (0.3) for about 40 s, then 5 g ketchup, 1 g sugar and 1 g salt went in. 4) 焖: 60 g water at medium (0.5), simmered at about 100 °C for roughly 90 s until the tomatoes were soft. 5) 勾芡 + 明油: 30 g starch water, stirred until thick, then a 5 g splash of finishing oil. 6) With the heat off, the eggs (147 g) went back in, got a few stir strokes, and the dish was tipped onto the plate. Changes from the video: no white vinegar, as instructed. About 20 g of egg-frying oil went back in with the eggs. The simmer ran a bit longer than 1 min.

decision.expect: The run ends with Wang Gang's tomato and egg plated: glossy red sauce, soft tomato wedges and golden egg pieces.
